newsitem.title: USA: Bolero offers five Baldwin Piano nominees.
newsitem.headline: Bolero offers five Baldwin Piano nominees.

text.p: Bolero Investment Group LP said Thursday it intends to propose five director nominees of Baldwin Piano & Organ Co.
The nominees are to be offered at the 1997 annual shareholders' meeting, it said.

Bolero's nominees include former South Carolina Gov. and former Saudi Arabia Ambassador John West; Edward McDonnell, who is on the board of directors of Seagram Co Ltd ; and former LD Nathan & Co Chief Executive Peter Cooper, who owns a private investment firm.
It also is nominating El Camino Resources Ltd President and Chief Executive David Harmon; and Robert Lippert, an economist.
Bolero holds a 6.5 percent stake in Baldwin, and has previously asked the company to explore a possible sale or merger.
Bolero said its proposal for the five nominees does not replace its previous request that Baldwin retain a "reputable" investment banker to explore alternatives.
Bolero has contended that Baldwin has failed to address slow sales, erratic earnings and poor stock performance.
